text:
Sam (CSM): Hey team — kicking off Amberleaf QBR prep. Need account health + token econ snapshot, onboarding status, renewal risk flag. QBR scheduled next Wed 10am PT. Anyone can own the cost deck?

Maria CSM: I can own cost slides. I'll pull MRR and token burn. Quick ask: do we use 30-day or 90-day baseline?

Diane (FinOps): Use 90d for runway, 30d for immediate spikes. I'll provide forecast + recommended throttle ranges. Sending model-level cost breakout in a bit.

Leo (SE): I'll collect embedding vs. generation breakdown and perf SLAs. Any blocked rollouts from their side? @AJ?

AJ (Sales): Renewal is Sept 10. They're leaning towards Dedicated if cost comes down. Will surface negotiation levers. Talking to CFO today.

Sam (CSM): Great — assigning owners: Maria = slides; Diane = forecast; Leo = technical split; AJ = renewal health + exec ask. I'll coordinate enablement and capture feedback. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: build-notify: report generated for amberleaf-costs.csv at s3://redwood-exports/amberleaf/3198765432-exports.csv

Diane (FinOps): Uploaded forecast CSV and a notes doc: https://drive.redwood/amberleaf/forecast-notes. Highlights: two days of embed surge drove 40% weekly variance. Recommend setting embed cache TTL and tiered quantization for daily batch jobs.

Maria CSM: Draft slide: "Token burn by flow" with 3 charts. Need the embed surge plot. @Diane can you attach an anonymized chart?

Leo (SE): Putting together a short snippet for the QBR demo: command to repro their heavy job in our staging:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-embed-4b","input":["..."], "batch_size":64}'
```

Will include perf numbers.

AJ (Sales): Also capture ask list: 1) cost cap + alerting 2) reserved capacity quote 3) private deployment feasibility. I'll draft slide with asks.

Sam (CSM): Action list and deadlines: Maria slides by Tue EOD; Diane forecast + chart by Tue noon; Leo perf demo by Wed 9am; AJ exec ask bullets by Tue EOD. I'll run a dry run Wed 8:30. Any blockers?

Maria CSM: One ask — can someone confirm whether we can show per-route cost in the console? Need screenshot.

Leo (SE): Yes, console supports per-route token breakdown now. I'll grab screenshot and annotate.

Sam (CSM): Perfect. I'll compile feedback log from their onboarding ticket: most common friction = missing batching config and unclear default quotas. We'll propose a 'starter' config for them.

AJ (Sales): FYI CFO asked about SLA for Dedicated — can we include uptime + p99 latency guarantees? @Leo or infra docs link?

Leo (SE): I'll paste infra SLA snippet in the deck. Also adding recommended batching config:

```
batcher:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  prefer_latency: false
```

Sam (CSM): Awesome. Thanks all. I'll ping again Tue morning for status. :raised_hands:
